scientific_integrity: A complete integer proof is provided and finite exact-arithmetic checks are independently reproducible. Finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof; no independent audit or formal verification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for positive even lengths and standard Fibonacci cubes only. Its novelty assessment is conditional on accessible literature; independent priority review may uncover equivalent results.
title: Exact common divisors of consecutive Fibonacci cubes at every even length
